Bloomberg.t: Asian Stocks Fall, Anthropic Slips in After-Hours: Markets Wrap
Bloomberg.tt: Asya'da Hisse Senedi Kayıpları Artacak, Nasdaq Vadeli İşlemleri Düşüş: Piyasalarda Gelişmeler
Bloomberg.s: Asian stocks sold off as pessimism over the artificial-intelligence trade hammered technology shares, with global equities set for their longest losing streak in three years. Anthropic PBC fell in after-hours trading after jumping on its market debut.
Bloomberg.ss: Anthropic PBC'nin piyasaya sağlam çıkışının yapay zeka ticaretine ilişkin karamsarlığı tersine çevirmede ve teknoloji hisselerinde daha geniş bir gerilemeyi önlemede başarısız olması nedeniyle Asya'da küresel hisse senedi satışlarının derinleşmesi bekleniyor.

Bloomberg.t: Gold Set for Worst Week Since March on Hawkish Fed, AI Selloff
Bloomberg.s: Gold fell and was heading for the biggest weekly decline since March, as a hawkish Federal Reserve signaled more interest-rate cuts and a selloff in AI stocks pushed investors to sell the metal to cover losses.

Bloomberg.t: Latest Oil Market News and Analysis for Nov. 20
Bloomberg.tt: 20 Kasım Ayı Son Petrol Piyasası Haberleri ve Analizleri
Bloomberg.s: Oil edged higher after a volatile session on Thursday, with futures on track for a third weekly decline as traders weigh the risk of renewed US strikes on Iran against ample supply.
Bloomberg.ss: Petrol Perşembe günkü dalgalı seansın ardından yükseldi; vadeli işlemler üçüncü haftalık düşüş yolunda ilerlerken, tüccarlar ABD'nin İran'a yeniden saldırı yapma riskini bol arz işaretleri karşısında değerlendiriyor.

Bloomberg.t: Fed Tells Regional Staff to Expect Lower Pay Hikes in 2027
Bloomberg.s: The Federal Reserve has warned employees at its regional outposts to expect lower pay increases next year, according to a memo viewed by Bloomberg News.

Bloomberg.t: Anthropic IPO Raises Only $110 Million From Australian Investors
Bloomberg.s: Australian investors were allocated less than 1% of total shares from Anthropic PBC’s record-breaking initial public offering.

Bloomberg.t: Anthropic Becomes World’s 7th Most Valuable Company After IPO
Bloomberg.s: Anthropic PBC’s blockbuster IPO lifted the company into the ranks of the most valuable in the world, with shares closing 17% from the offer price to give it a $1.8 trillion fully diluted market value.

Bloomberg.t: Nintendo Gains as ‘Roaring Kitty’ Posts Mario Character on X
Bloomberg.s: Nintendo Co.’s American depositary receipts soared Thursday after an account associated with Keith Gill, the online persona known as “Roaring Kitty,” posted an image of the firm’s mascot on X.

Bloomberg.t: Treasury Official Renews Warning on Wave of Tax-Saving Trades
Bloomberg.tt: Hazine Yetkilisi Vergi Tasarruflu Ticaret Dalgasına İlişkin Uyarıyı Yeniledi
Bloomberg.s: A senior US Treasury official reiterated concerns Thursday about Wall Street’s tax-efficient investing boom, saying firms should win clients on the merits of their investments, not on how far they’ll go to minimize a tax bill.
Bloomberg.ss: Üst düzey bir ABD Hazine yetkilisi Perşembe günü Wall Street'in vergi açısından verimli yatırım patlamasıyla ilgili endişelerini yineledi ve firmaların vergi faturasını en aza indirmek için ne kadar ileri gideceklerine göre değil, yatırımlarının değerine göre müşteri kazanması gerektiğini söyledi.
